title: AI, skills and jobs: building a two-sector model
intro: A model of how efficiency-improving technology moves prices, pay and jobs, built step by step. Each stage below is kept as it was when completed, so earlier results stay available as the model grows.

stages.title: Stage 1: one sector, first test model
stages.summary: One sector plus “everything else”, with one and then four worker types; technology that augments or automates. Research’s tests 1–10 with expected values, charts of Bessen’s inverted U, augmenting and the hand-loom case, the two presets’ base years, and the first regime maps at three values of θ.

stages.title: Stage 2: two sectors and the supply chain
stages.summary: The second sector, the two-way supply chain between manufacturing and design, and both presets solved.
